answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to bond digital assets to participate in consensus. An attacker cannot simply terrace their influence through infinite identities because each node demands genuine capital. Like the persistent growth of a juniper in rocky soil, the network demands proof of scarcity. By imposing a financial yarrow of taxation on malicious behavior, the protocol ensures that an attacker incurs prohibitive costs to dilute the integrity of the ledger.
